text: step 1: ONE finger: TAP 3 times (tap to click)
end step 1
step 2: THREE fingers: swipe LEFT very SLOWLY, once
end step 2
step 3: FOUR fingers: drag a window onto the CENTRE of another, lift
end step 3
step 4: FOUR fingers: drag a window onto the EDGE of another, lift
end step 4
step 5: FOUR fingers: FLICK a window fast towards another screen
end step 5
step 6: FOUR fingers: drag, then lift ONE finger at a time
end step 6
step 7: THREE fingers: swipe UP and DOWN on the group you made
end step 7
step 8: MOUSE: hold WIN + turn the wheel, cursor on the TOP screen
end step 8
step 9: MOUSE: hold WIN + turn the wheel, cursor on the PORTRAIT screen
end step 9
step 10: MOUSE: hold WIN + turn the wheel, cursor on the LAPTOP screen
end step 10
